ports.label: Legend alignment
ports.description: Define the alignment where the legend should be displayed. Possible values are 0 = Upper left, 1 = Upper center, 2 = Upper right, 3 = Middle left, 4 = Middle center, 5 = Middle right, 6 = Lower left, 7 = Lower center, 8 = Lower right.

ports.label: Y axis interval
ports.description: Define a custom interval for the displayed Y-axis value range.

ports.label: Colors
ports.description: Input one color per plotted trace for your input data. If the number of colors is less than the number of plotted traces, then the color values are repeated.

ports.label: Line styles
ports.description: Choose the line style for the plot. 0 = None, 1 = Solid, 2 = Dash, 3 = Dash Dot, 4 = Dash Dot Dot, 5 = Dot. Please provide one style for all plotted traces or one style for each branch. If the number of styles is less than the number of traces, then the styles are repeated.

ports.label: Line widths
ports.description: Specify the line width connecting the data points. Please provide one width for all plotted traces or one width for each branch. If the number of widths is less than the number of traces, then the widths are repeated.

ports.label: Marker shapes
ports.description: Choose the marker shape for the plot. 0 = None, 1 = Filled circle, 2 = Filled square, 3 = Open circle, 4 = Open square, 5 = Filled diamond, 6 = Open diamond, 7 = Asterisk, 8 = Hashtag, 9 = Cross, 10 = X, 11 = Vertical bar, 12 = Tri upwards, 13 = Tri downwards, 14 = Filled triangle upwards, 15 = Filled triangle downwards, 16 = Open triangle upwards, 17 = Open triangle downwards. Please provide one shape for all plotted traces or one shape for each branch. If the number of shapes is less than the number of traces, then the shapes are repeated.

ports.label: Marker sizes
ports.description: Specify the size of the markers which point to your given values. Please provide one size for all plotted traces or one size for each branch. If the number of sizes is less than the number of traces, then the sizes are repeated.

ports.label: X axis label
ports.description: Label of the horizontal x-axis.

ports.label: Y axis label
ports.description: Label of the vertical y-axis.

ports.label: Logarithmic Y axis
ports.description: If set to true, the Y axis will use a logarithmic scale with a base of 10.

ports.label: Image background color
ports.description: Specify the background color that is used by the whole image. By default, it's set to white.

ports.label: Data background color
ports.description: Specify the background color that is used by the rectangle that contains the data. By default, it's set to white.

ports.label: X mode
ports.description: Automatic uses the first numeric/datetime column when multiple usable columns exist. Sample index ignores X columns.

ports.label: X column
ports.description: Exact column name or zero-based position, used in Column X mode. Position choices display one-based labels.

ports.label: Y columns
ports.description: Ordered exact column names or zero-based positions. Leave empty to select numeric Y columns automatically.

ports.label: Maximum rendered points
ports.description: Maximum points per rendered trace, preserving extrema and gaps. Zero renders full resolution; source data is unchanged.

ports.label: Datetime X start
ports.description: Optional ISO-8601 date or timestamp for the displayed X minimum. Naive timestamps use UTC.

ports.label: Datetime X end
ports.description: Optional ISO-8601 date or timestamp for the displayed X maximum. Naive timestamps use UTC.

ports.label: Image
ports.description: Image data from your plot.

spec.description: Plot numeric signals, arrays and table columns against sample index or explicit numeric/datetime X values.
